description: MCP tools for cyclic peptide computational analysis using MCTS reinforcement learning

tools.name: analyze_cyclic_peptide
tools.description: Analyze cyclic peptide-protein interactions with binding metrics and mutation suggestions
tools.example_prompt: Analyze the cyclic peptide XVPLRARNLPPSFFTEPX binding to protein 6seo with mutation suggestions

tools.name: train_mcts_generate_data
tools.description: Generate training data for MCTS policy-value network

tools.name: train_mcts_evaluate_model
tools.description: Evaluate a trained MCTS policy-value model
tools.example_prompt: Evaluate the trained model at models/policy_value_net.pkl

tools.name: submit_mcts_training
tools.description: Submit MCTS policy-value network training job
tools.example_prompt: Train an MCTS policy-value network for 16-residue peptides with 100 epochs and batch size 32

tools.name: submit_peptide_design
tools.description: Submit cyclic peptide design job using MCTS optimization
tools.example_prompt: Design a 16-residue cyclic peptide that binds to protein 6seo using 300 MCTS optimization iterations

tools.name: submit_batch_peptide_analysis
tools.description: Submit batch analysis job for multiple cyclic peptides
tools.example_prompt: Submit batch analysis for multiple peptides with mutation suggestions

scripts.name: analyze_peptide.py
scripts.description: Analyze cyclic peptide-protein interactions with binding metrics and mutation suggestions

scripts.name: train_mcts.py
scripts.description: Train and evaluate MCTS policy-value networks for peptide optimization

scripts.name: design_peptide.py
scripts.description: Design cyclic peptides using MCTS reinforcement learning optimization

configs.description: Configuration for cyclic peptide analysis and mutation suggestions

examples.name: Quick Property Analysis
examples.goal: Analyze binding properties of a known cyclic peptide
examples.mcp_prompt: Analyze the cyclic peptide from PDB entry 6seo in the demo data. Include mutation suggestions for improved binding.
examples.expected_output: Binding score: 0.493, plDDT confidence: 79.0, mutation suggestions

examples.name: MCTS Peptide Design
examples.goal: Design a novel cyclic peptide targeting protein 6seo
examples.mcp_prompt: Design a 16-residue cyclic peptide that binds to protein 6seo using MCTS optimization with 300 iterations.
examples.expected_output: Job ID for tracking, optimized peptide sequence

examples.name: Neural Network Training
examples.goal: Train a policy-value network for peptide optimization
examples.mcp_prompt: Generate 5000 training samples for 16-residue peptides, then train the network with 100 epochs
examples.expected_output: Training data, trained model, evaluation metrics

troubleshooting: Environment not found: recreate with mamba/conda
RDKit import errors: install from conda-forge
MCP server not found: re-add to Claude Code
Invalid peptide sequence: use standard amino acid codes
Job failed: check job logs with get_job_log
